stories.title: Muere Maricarmen, la anciana de 87 años desahuciada en Madrid

en.title: Maricarmen, 87-year-old evicted woman in Madrid, dies
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman who became a symbol of housing crisis activism after being evicted in Madrid died at Gregorio Marañón Hospital. Her case had sparked protests at Puerta del Sol.

stories.title: La UCO confirma que la cloaca del PSOE contactó con los narcos para «eliminar» a la juez del caso del hermano de Sánchez

en.title: UCO confirms PSOE underground network contacted drug traffickers to "eliminate" judge in Sánchez's brother case
en.summary: The Civil Guard's Central Operational Unit reported that alleged PSOE underground operatives contacted drug traffickers from Badajoz about targeting judge Beatriz Biedma, who was investigating the president's brother.

stories.title: Masivo duelo de los acampados de Sol ante el Congreso por Maricarmen: "¡Vergüenza!"

en.title: Massive vigil by Sol tent residents before Congress for Maricarmen: "Shame!"
en.summary: Protesters gathered at Sol encampment demonstrated before Congress, chanting accusations against landlords and expressing outrage over Maricarmen's death.

stories.title: “Maricarmen tiene que ser la última víctima del sistema”: cientos de acampados marchan desde Sol al Congreso

en.title: "Maricarmen must be the last victim of the system": hundreds of campers march from Sol to Congress
en.summary: Hundreds of protesters from the Sol encampment marched to Congress following the death of Maricarmen, shouting slogans demanding that she be the last victim of the housing system.

stories.title: Los acampados en Sol marchan hacia el Congreso en homenaje a Maricarmen: “No son muertes, son asesinatos”

en.title: Protesters camped at Sol march toward Congress in tribute to Maricarmen: "These are not deaths, they are murders"
en.summary: Demonstrators at a Madrid plaza camp have marched to Congress to honor an elderly woman who became a symbol of housing rights activism. Her death has prompted shock among protesters gathered at the central location.

stories.title: Muere Maricarmen Abascal a los 87 años, dos semanas después del desahucio de su casa de Madrid

en.title: Maricarmen Abascal dies at 87, two weeks after her Madrid home eviction
en.summary: An elderly woman with disabilities was evicted from her home on September 23 and hospitalized, but later reached an agreement to return. She has since died at age 87.

stories.title: Muere Maricarmen, la mujer que fue desahuciada en Madrid: última hora y reacciones en directo

en.title: Maricarmen, the woman evicted in Madrid, dies: latest updates and live reactions
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman's death has sparked a gathering near Congress where attendees lit candles and held a moment of silence in her memory.

stories.title: CCOO y UGT llaman a la huelga general el 11-N para "acabar con la especulación de la vivienda" y que "se ponga control a la deriva de los precios"

en.title: CCOO and UGT call for general strike on November 11 to "end housing speculation" and "control price surge"
en.summary: Two major trade unions have announced a general strike scheduled for November 11 to address housing affordability and rising prices.

stories.title: Frente Amplio: la vía Colau como candidata acerca a Podemos pero la lista de Madrid es un polvorín por la batalla entre los partidos

en.title: Broad Front: Colau as candidate brings Podemos closer but Madrid list is a powder keg due to battle between parties
en.summary: Más Madrid demands leadership and control of the candidate list in its constituency, while IU insists on fair treatment to participate in the Broad Front coalition.

stories.title: Muere Maricarmen, la mujer que encendió la lucha contra los desahucios en España

en.title: Maricarmen, the woman who sparked the fight against evictions in Spain, dies
en.summary: An 87-year-old activist who led efforts against housing evictions in Spain passed away at a Madrid hospital, according to tenants' union confirmation.

stories.title: Más Madrid propone que Colau sea la candidata del Frente Amplio a la presidencia del Gobierno y encabece la lista en Barcelona

en.title: Más Madrid proposes that Colau be the Broad Front candidate for president and lead the list in Barcelona
en.summary: Más Madrid has proposed Ada Colau as the presidential candidate for the Broad Front coalition and as the lead candidate in Barcelona. Mónica García will head the list in Madrid.

stories.title: Los Reyes invitarán a representantes civiles de Ceuta y Melilla el 12 de octubre, y ya perfilan la agenda de su visita a las ciudades autónomas

en.title: The King and Queen will invite civil representatives from Ceuta and Melilla on October 12, and are already planning their visit agenda to the autonomous cities
en.summary: The Spanish Royal Household is organizing a visit to Ceuta and Melilla for October 12, scheduled after the National Holiday, with civil society representatives invited.

stories.title: OpenAI renueva ChatGPT: así luce la nueva interfaz que responde con imágenes y botones

en.title: OpenAI renews ChatGPT: this is how the new interface looks that responds with images and buttons
en.summary: OpenAI unveiled Intelligent UI, a redesigned interface for its chatbot featuring its most advanced model GPT-6, available to both paid and free-plan users.

stories.title: Las actas de la Fed apuntan a otra subida de tipos antes de final de año

en.title: Fed minutes point to another rate increase before end of year
en.summary: Federal Reserve meeting notes indicate a majority of members are considering a second interest rate increase before 2027, raising expectations for a December rate hike.

stories.title: Muere Maricarmen, la mujer de 87 años desahuciada en Madrid que avivó las protestas

en.title: Maricarmen, the 87-year-old woman evicted in Madrid who fueled protests, dies
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman whose eviction sparked public protests has died at a Madrid hospital.

stories.title: Yolanda Díaz pisa el acelerador para anunciar la subida del salario mínimo de 2027 antes de las elecciones

en.title: Yolanda Díaz accelerates plans to announce 2027 minimum wage increase before elections
en.summary: The labor minister is convening an expert committee to establish recommendations for minimum wage adjustment in 2027 ahead of general elections.

stories.title: El caos ferroviario en Cataluña enturbia el arranque de la precampaña de las generales

en.title: Railway chaos in Catalonia clouds start of general election precampaign
en.summary: Railway disruptions in Catalonia are emerging as a complicating factor at the beginning of the general election precampaign period.
